data.sub: Bathinda mein shuru hua desh ka pehla wheelchair cricket tournament.

chat.say: Cricket ka junoon ho toh koi rok nahi sakta.
Hausla ho toh har mushkil aasan hai!

data.asar: Pata chalta hai ki asli junoon kisi rukaawat ko nahi maanta.
data.caption:
Desh mein shuru hua ek naya aur shandar safar! 🏏

• Bathinda se hui shuruat
• Desh ka pehla wheelchair cricket tournament
• BCCI ke sahyog se hua aayojan

Hausle ke aage saari rukawatein haar jaati hain!

Save kar lo, baad mein kaam aayega.
